displays.title: Energy highlight
displays.question: What does the accepted evidence tell us about power for AI?
displays.rule: Keep forecast editions separate; consumption is not generation or delivered capacity.

displays.title: Chips highlight
displays.question: What does the accepted evidence tell us about chip supply?
displays.rule: Packaging estimates are not accelerator shipments; retain ranges and vintages.

displays.title: Infrastructure highlight
displays.question: What infrastructure is delivering compute?
displays.rule: Operating IT power, facility power and promised end-state capacity are distinct.

displays.title: Models highlight
displays.question: What capability does compute make available?
displays.rule: Named API prices are scoped snapshots, not intelligence or productivity measures.

displays.title: Applications highlight
displays.question: Where is intelligence doing useful work?
displays.rule: Usage is not productivity; retain service footprint, quality and outcome denominators.

displays.title: The pace of construction
displays.question: How is physical building activity changing?
displays.rule: Same-month, same-source-vintage comparison only; nominal SAAR is neither annual spending nor AI-only investment.

displays.title: The work needs people
displays.question: How is recruitment demand changing?
displays.rule: Keep the approved 2023 baseline. Posting share, posting volume and hires differ; rounded endpoints do not establish intermediate history.

displays.title: Larger projects. Larger workforce plans.
displays.question: What workforce is proposed for upcoming projects?
displays.rule: No combined jobs total; peak construction, permanent positions and company commitments remain separate.

displays.title: From construction crews to an operating AI campus
displays.question: What does a reported operating campus mean for physical work?
displays.rule: Pinned June 2026 Fairwater case. Cumulative contributors over two years are not simultaneous workers; on-site employees are not necessarily Microsoft payroll.

displays.title: Global hyperscaler capital spending
displays.question: How much is the covered hyperscaler cohort investing?
displays.rule: Require the complete cohort for totals. Keep cash/lease accounting, fiscal/calendar periods, actuals and forecast vintages visible. No mixed-basis growth calculation or reinstatement of the archived forecast.

displays.title: Buildout map
displays.question: Where is the buildout happening and what stage has each site reached?
displays.rule: City/county pins show approximate locality. Resolve aliases and parent overlaps; offices, service markets and facilities are distinct. Pin count is not capacity or complete coverage.

displays.title: Model capability frontier
displays.question: How are measured model capabilities changing?
displays.rule: Use the complete reviewed ECI snapshot and uncertainty. Do not splice score vintages or infer business productivity. Unknown country/developer metadata stays unknown.

displays.title: U.S. electricity generation: history and outlook
displays.question: Are generation and published outlooks keeping pace?
displays.rule: Utility-scale and broader generation scopes differ. GW is not TWh; preserve baseline, scenario and vintage. A capacity-factor illustration is not a forecast. Do not cut supported horizons at 2030.

displays.title: Claims & Evidence
displays.question: What can we establish about community benefits and costs?
displays.rule: Check contrary evidence, geography and denominator. Tax receipts alone do not prove household tax savings; local gross jobs do not prove national net employment.

displays.title: Company revenue and industrial suppliers
displays.question: Who supplies the buildout and what business is being realized?
displays.rule: Company revenue is not AI-only revenue or industry value added. Preserve currency, fiscal dates, segment boundaries and forecasts; missing revenue is not zero.

displays.title: Chip capacity and product delivery
displays.question: Which supply bottlenecks are improving?
displays.rule: Separate wafer starts, packaging, HBM, accelerators, networking specifications and actual shipments. Proposed production is not delivered capacity.

displays.title: Useful intelligence and medicine
displays.question: What useful work and scientific outcomes have been demonstrated?
displays.rule: Adoption and code-review counts are not hours saved. Separate benchmark, deployment, lab validation, clinical endpoints, approval and patient outcomes.

displays.title: What changed recently?
displays.question: Which material developments deserve the reader's attention now?
displays.rule: Check event dates separately from publication and review; no automatic promotion of accepted research notes. Avoid duplicates and stale cards.

displays.title: Inside the five layers
displays.question: Do the diagrams accurately explain how the layers fit together?
displays.rule: Preserve layer colors and approved structure. No inferred supplier relationship. Runtime/hardware is excluded from all proposals.
